# Kelvarix

> Convert your business to AI with Kelvarix — AI agents that absorb business busywork inside the tools you already use.

Kelvarix is an AI operations studio. We take over follow-ups, chasing, invoices, inbox, WhatsApp, CRM sync, reporting and Tier-1 support, and ship custom tools (invoice systems, CRMs, conversion websites, SEO/GEO/AEO trackers) that the client owns.

- Homepage: https://kelvarix.in/
- Contact: enquiry@kelvarix.in
- What we do: lead response in <60s, follow-up and booking with 0 leads dropped, call transcription with 100% capture, invoice automation (-80% admin hours), 24/7 WhatsApp coverage, ticket deflection (-60% load), zero double-entry sync, plain-English daily digest, custom invoicing (-70% tool cost), call-insight mining (100% analysed), custom CRM (-60% CRM cost), 2x-conversion websites, daily rank tracking, competitor monitoring.
- How it works: (1) 30-minute workflow call, (2) written blueprint with escalation rules and one measurable KPI, (3) agent live in weeks, wired into CRM, calendar, inbox, WhatsApp and sheets.
- Industries: Real Estate, E-commerce, Healthcare, Law Firms, Agencies.
- Pricing: fixed scope, quoted after a free mapping call. Reply within 24 hours.

Keywords: convert your business to AI with Kelvarix, AI agents, AI operations studio, business automation.
